keyQuestions: Is MCP a first-class Pi feature or a plugin-sized gap?
answeredQuestions: Confirmed core gap: Pi does not present MCP as a built-in primitive. An extension may add integration, but that is not equivalent to native first-class support.
noveltyJustification: Identified a real product-boundary difference without inferring implementation impossibility.
